Project.NAME: hrf/vast
Project.keywords: vast, boardgame, digital adaptation, scalajs, browser game, rules engine, ai bot
Project.annotation: Browser-playable digital adaptation of Vast: The Crystal Caverns focused on deterministic rules enforcement, replayable action/state transitions, and future AI bot strength.

M-VAST-META.NAME: VastMeta
M-VAST-META.purpose: Declares the Vast game identity, supported factions, assets, action parsing/writing hooks, and bot selection surface.

export-Meta.PURPOSE: Registers the Vast game in the shared HRF meta registry.

M-VAST-GAME.NAME: VastGameLogic
M-VAST-GAME.purpose: Implements factions, board state, actions, hidden information, rule enforcement, and win-condition resolution for Vast.
M-VAST-GAME.path: vast/game.scala; vast/game-setup.scala; vast/game-goblins.scala; vast/game-dragon.scala; vast/game-cave-tail.scala; vast/game-board-tail.scala

type-Action.PURPOSE: Rule-driven transition surface for the game engine.

trait-GameSetupSupport.PURPOSE: Extracted setup/startup helper dispatch used to reduce `Game.performInternal` bytecode pressure.

M-VAST-UI.NAME: VastBrowserUI
M-VAST-UI.purpose: Renders the cave, tokens, factions, overlays, and interaction surface in the browser.

export-UI.PURPOSE: Browser UI implementation registered for Vast.

M-VAST-SERIALIZE.NAME: VastSerialization
M-VAST-SERIALIZE.purpose: Serializes and parses externalized Vast actions for replay, transport, and debugging.

export-Serialize.PURPOSE: Stable write/parse surface for Vast actions.

M-VAST-BOT.NAME: VastBots
M-VAST-BOT.purpose: Provides heuristic and faction-specific bot decision logic and the main extension point for stronger AI play.

class-BotXX.PURPOSE: Generic evaluation-based bot fallback for factions.

class-GameEvaluation.PURPOSE: Action scoring surface that future stronger bots can replace or extend.

M-VAST-THIEF-SUPPORT.NAME: VastThiefSupport
M-VAST-THIEF-SUPPORT.purpose: Implement the Thief role as a supported fifth player across setup, rules logic, UI, serialization, and bot/simulation boundaries.
M-VAST-THIEF-SUPPORT.path: vast/game.scala; vast/game-thief.scala; vast/game-setup.scala; vast/meta.scala; vast/ui.scala; vast/serialize.scala; vast/bot.scala; vast/VastHost.scala
M-VAST-THIEF-SUPPORT.depends: M-VAST-RULES, M-VAST-GAME, M-VAST-META, M-VAST-UI, M-VAST-SERIALIZE, M-VAST-BOT, M-VAST-HOST

type-Thief.PURPOSE: Fifth-player faction aligned with `rules/thief.xml`; partially enabled in setup and basic turn flow.

type-ThiefPlayer.PURPOSE: Runtime state for Thief stats, action cubes, carried loot, stashed loot, path, and per-turn targeting.

slice-MinimalBoot.PURPOSE: Five-player setup, Vault tile inclusion, Entrance placement, and placeholder/status UI.

slice-CoreTurn.PURPOSE: Basic stat assignment defaults, movement, dark-tile reveal choice, and end-turn path cleanup.

slice-LootVaultStash.PURPOSE: Basic Loot, Pick Lock, carried/stashed loot, Dragon Gem stash handling, and six-stash victory.

slice-CrossFaction.PURPOSE: Pickpocket, Backstab, Unnatural Evasion, and incoming Knight/Goblins/Dragon/Cave effects require dispatch extraction before more handlers are added.

slice-Pickpocket.PURPOSE: Pickpocket action with per-faction steal effects and roll mechanics.

slice-Backstab.PURPOSE: Backstab action with Light/Moderate/Heavy injury per faction.

slice-HideLoot.PURPOSE: Hide Loot action reducing Loot Drop Level.

slice-Climb.PURPOSE: Climb action through walls (2 cubes) with Climbing Gear upgrade.

slice-UpgradeBoard.PURPOSE: Upgrade board with 5 specials and stat boosts on stash.

slice-DeathRewards.PURPOSE: Death rewards by Loot Drop Level and respawn logic.

slice-UnnaturalEvasion.PURPOSE: Evasion roll on first incoming attack per turn.

trait-GameThiefSupport.PURPOSE: Extracted Thief helper dispatch and verification markers for the partial 5p checkpoint.

constraint-JVMMethodLimit.PURPOSE: `performInternal`, parts 2–3 use lift PFs (`GameGoblinsSupport`, `GameDragonSupport`). `caveTailPart3` chains `GameCaveTailSupport#caveTailCaveDispatchPart3`, `GameThiefSupport#thiefCaveTailDispatchPart3`, `GameBoardTailSupport#boardTailDispatchPart3` (`orElse` order); extend via traits before ballooning matches.

trait-GameGoblinsSupport.PURPOSE: Goblins `PartialFunction` extracted for bytecode and clarity; requires implicit `Game` at call like other faction dispatches.

trait-GameDragonSupport.PURPOSE: Dragon `PartialFunction` extracted for bytecode and clarity; requires implicit `Game` at call for `GameImplicits` (e.g. `dragonToPlayer`).

trait-GameCaveTailSupport.PURPOSE: Cave omen-main and Cave end-turn `PartialFunction` for `caveTailPart3`; excludes thief bridge between early Cave arms and CaveMain continuation.

trait-GameBoardTailSupport.PURPOSE: Collapse/reconnect/map-fill/generic turn-tail `PartialFunction`; `EndPlayerTurnAction` rotates `factions` on `Game` (not private `implicit game`).

M-VAST-HOST.NAME: VastHostSimulation
M-VAST-HOST.purpose: Runs host-side automated or semi-automated simulations for bot play and serialization validation outside the browser UI.

export-Host.PURPOSE: Simulation entry point for repeated bot-driven Vast runs.

M-VAST-RULES.NAME: VastRulesCorpus
M-VAST-RULES.purpose: Stores semantically structured XML rules used as the authoritative rules reference for gameplay verification and future AI grounding.
M-VAST-RULES.path: rules/index.xml; rules/general.xml; rules/knight.xml; rules/goblins.xml; rules/dragon.xml; rules/cave.xml; rules/thief.xml; rules/terrain-and-variants.xml

export-rules-index.PURPOSE: Entry point describing rule documents and topic coverage.

M-HRF-WEB-RUNTIME.NAME: HRFBrowserRuntime
M-HRF-WEB-RUNTIME.purpose: Bootstraps the shared browser app, loads resources, selects game meta modules, and serves Vast through the shared HRF runtime.

export-HRF.PURPOSE: Top-level browser runtime and resource bootstrap.
